name: P-015 R-4 real-backend identity UI journey: pointer-driven select, review, switch and rollback in the rendered Tauri webview, each reaching an applied host activation
commandBasis: Reconstructed, not copied from a shell log: the driver refuses to run without PAPERCUSP_VERIFY_TAURI_ISOLATED=1 (set by VERIFY_TAURI_ISOLATED_DB=1) and records realBackend=true only when P015_R4_REAL_BACKEND=1, and the artifact shows both. exitCode 0 is inferred from status=pass; the driver sets a nonzero exit on any failed step or cleanup.
summary: The maintained R-4 driver (scripts/verify-identities-r4.mjs, real-backend branch) ran inside verify-tauri-headless.sh against an isolated Tauri webview and isolated Postgres (workspace verify-tauri-isolated-90). It drove the rendered /settings/identities page with pointer clicks. It selected the owned roster agent, reviewed the effective-configuration diff, switched identity through the real identity-management backend, and saw change-requested then applied after the host acknowledged. It then rolled back through the same path and saw change-requested then applied again. All 36 steps passed, with realBackend=true, syntheticMutationResponses=false and hostActivationProven=true. The raw driver artifact is docs/evidence/p015-r4-real-backend-2026-09-21.json (sha256 below); this file is its operational-test-evidence envelope.
timeBasis: startedAt is the driver's own run stamp (outDir p015-r4-identities-2026-09-21T145007677Z, and the owner id suffix 1790002207677 ms). finishedAt is an UPPER BOUND: the time the observer recorded check r4-real-backend-applied on WI-2143764 (sinceMs 1790002424395), after the run completed. The driver does not stamp its own finish time.

subject.note: A disposable owner seeded in the verifier's isolated database. The UI, the identity-management route and the host activation acknowledgement are the production code paths, not mocks.

rawArtifact.redaction: Home-directory paths in recorded commands were rewritten by redactIdentityLeaks on 2026-09-22 so git-sync's content guard would admit the file. The pre-redaction sha256 is kept in the artifact's identityRedaction block. No observation changed.

replication.expect: exit 0 and evidence.json with status=pass, realBackend=true, hostActivationProven=true, observed covering real-switch-applied and real-rollback-applied

assertions.evidence: Steps owned-agent-visible, identity-library-visible, owned-agent-selected, real-select-identity: every transition used a real pointer click on an element scrolled into the viewport (the driver refuses a target outside the viewport).
Steps real-review-switch, real-review-response, real-review-diff-visible: the diff came from the identity-management backend, not client-side state.
Steps real-switch-change-requested then real-switch-host-ack then real-switch-applied: requested state was shown as requested, and applied appeared only after the host acknowledgement.
Steps real-rollback-change-requested, real-rollback-host-ack, real-rollback-applied: rollback went through the same backend path and reached applied.
realBackend=true, syntheticMutationResponses=false; the driver's fetch observer recorded real /api identity-management calls (step eval:observe-real-fetch).

notProven: Failure-banner rendering on the REAL backend. The failure/retry path is proven by the controlled-response run (docs/evidence/p015-r4-controlled-ui-2026-09-20.json), not this one.
Provider-binding selection (a missing provider silently selected). Not exercised by this journey.
Full P-015 or plan acceptance. This is scoped R-4 evidence.
